name: lightrag
title: LightRAG Knowledge Base
description: Search and manage documents in your self-hosted LightRAG server.
author: armin_goffin

commands.name: index
commands.title: LightRAG Status
commands.description: Check the connection status of your LightRAG server

tools.name: query-lightrag
tools.title: Query LightRAG (Answer)
tools.description: Ask the knowledge base in natural language and get a generated answer (RAG), with optional source references. Use for normal questions about papers and notes (e.g. explanations, comparisons). Do NOT use for raw graph dumps — use "Query LightRAG (structured data)" instead. Modes: mix (default), local, global, hybrid, naive, bypass.

tools.name: query-lightrag-data
tools.title: Query LightRAG (Structured Data)
tools.description: Retrieve structured retrieval results WITHOUT a generated prose answer: entities, relationships, text chunks, and references (JSON). Use for evidence inspection, debugging retrieval, or analyzing what would feed a RAG answer. Not for casual Q&A — use "Query LightRAG (answer)" for that.

tools.name: list-documents
tools.title: List Documents
tools.description: Browse documents with pagination and filters (status, sort). Use to list files, see filenames/paths, timestamps, and per-status counts on the page. For a quick global count by status without listing rows, use "Document Status Counts". Not for answering content questions — use query tools.

tools.name: get-document-status-counts
tools.title: Document Status Counts
tools.description: Returns only how many documents are in each status (PENDING, PROCESSING, etc.) — lightweight, no filenames. Use for dashboards or "how many failed?". To list actual files or pages, use "List Documents" instead.

tools.name: get-health
tools.title: Get Server Health
tools.description: Server-wide health and configuration: LLM/embedding models, auth mode, versions, pipeline_busy, WebUI. Use for "is the server up?", model names, or connectivity. Not for per-document processing progress — use "Pipeline status" for the indexing pipeline.

tools.name: get-pipeline-status
tools.title: Pipeline Status
tools.description: Detailed document indexing pipeline state: busy, current job, batches, progress messages/history. Use when the user asks whether ingestion/indexing is running, stuck, or what the pipeline is doing. Not the same as server health — use "Get Server Health" for models and global status.

tools.name: insert-text
tools.title: Insert Text (Raycast Notes)
tools.description: Insert a text note into LightRAG for later retrieval (e.g. summaries or chat notes). Always tagged with a dedicated Raycast chat text file_source so it is distinguishable from PDFs. Returns a track_id for background processing; use "Pipeline Status" for overall indexing activity, or "Track Status" with that track_id to see this batch’s processing state.

tools.name: get-track-status
tools.title: Track Status
tools.description: Look up processing state for a specific track_id (returned by insert-text, upload, or text insert APIs). Use when the user asks whether a particular upload or note batch finished, failed, or is still processing. Not a substitute for "Pipeline Status" (global pipeline) or "List Documents" (file listing).

tools.name: list-graph-labels
tools.title: List Graph Labels
tools.description: Returns all entity/label strings in the knowledge graph (can be large). Use to enumerate graph vocabulary. For fuzzy lookup by substring, prefer "Search Graph Labels"; for central topics by connectivity, prefer "Popular Graph Labels".

tools.name: get-popular-graph-labels
tools.title: Popular Graph Labels
tools.description: Labels ranked by graph connectivity (degree) — "hub" concepts. Use for overview of dominant themes. Not a full list — use "List Graph Labels" for that. Not for natural-language Q&A — use query tools.

tools.name: search-graph-labels
tools.title: Search Graph Labels
tools.description: Fuzzy search for label names matching a query string. Use to find how a concept is named in the graph before opening a subgraph. Not for document content search — use "Query LightRAG" tools for that.

tools.name: get-knowledge-graph
tools.title: Knowledge Graph Subgraph
tools.description: Returns a connected subgraph around one starting label. Defaults: max_depth 3, max_nodes 64 (keeps Raycast tool output readable). Long fields (e.g. description, file_path) are truncated unless full_properties is true — full_properties may hit Raycast "message too long". Increase max_nodes only if needed. Requires an exact label — use "Search Graph Labels" first if unsure of spelling.

tools.name: check-entity-exists
tools.title: Check Entity Exists
tools.description: Quick boolean check whether an entity name exists in the graph. Use before merge/rename-style questions or to validate a label string. Does not return relationships — use "Knowledge Graph Subgraph" or query-data for structure.

preferences.name: serverUrl
preferences.title: LightRAG Server URL
preferences.description: The base URL of your LightRAG server including protocol and port.
